hero.title: Logistics and Fulfillment
hero.subtitle2: Share information to prevent disruption and deliver on service expectations.

intro.title: On-time delivery demands real-time insight
intro.paragraph: In logistics management, being on time and meeting customer expectations is everything. Dispatchers need to prepare for any threat to delivery operations—from contamination to natural disasters to theft. Easy-to-understand digital dashboards that fuse location intelligence and all operational data provide real-time insights. Adjustments can be made in the moment, and delays minimized to stay on schedule.

band.title: On-time delivery demands real-time insight
band.body: Get a real-time view of logistics operations with location intelligence. Monitor routes, orders, and network health to predict arrival time, protect reputation, and keep operations on schedule.

routes.title: See the smartest routes others can’t
routes.intro: The world’s largest delivery companies use location intelligence to optimize routes, arrive when projected, and meet high customer service expectations.
bullets: Deliver on your promise of products, services, and order fulfillment.
Optimize routes based on customer location, time windows, cargo transfers, and other factors.
Manage risk by planning for natural disasters and other events.
Respond to disruptions in real time and adjust to protect your fulfillment reputation.
Reduce costs with smart routing and other location tools.

capabilities.title: Capabilities
capabilities.blurb: Get the best routing decisions and a real-time view of logistics operations using location intelligence technology from the Esri Geospatial Cloud.

items.title: Real-Time Visualization and Analytics
items.body: Analyze and display real-time data from sensors, devices, and social media feeds. Gain situational awareness from your streaming data whether you are tracking moving assets or stationary sensors.

items.title: Spatial Analysis and Data Science
items.body: See hidden patterns in your supply chain data. Access spatial analysis capabilities on demand and at scale with the Esri Geospatial Cloud.

items.title: Imagery and Remote Sensing
items.body: Access imagery and remote-sensing data feeds to monitor delivery status. Obtain timely answers based on real-time data visualized in a smart map.

items.title: Operational Efficiency
items.body: Streamline projects and identify areas that need improvement. Rely on authoritative data to reduce errors and better allocate resources.

items.title: Asset Tracking and Analysis
items.body: Visualize moving and fixed assets dynamically. Improve performance with monitoring tools to accurately record the locations and health of your assets.

items.title: Situational Awareness
items.body: Be proactive: make better decisions by integrating, analyzing, and displaying data from sensors, devices, and social/media feeds.
